gloss: head of a household, family head

definitions.gloss: head of a household, family head, master of the house
definitions.explanation: The current leader or head of a family, clan, or household. Often used in the context of traditional families, noble houses, or business dynasties, where succession from one generation to the next is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一家|いっか}→一家：01723_ikka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{当主|とうしゅ}だ。
examples.english: He is the head of the family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先代|せんだい}→先代：14793_sendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{当主|とうしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{亡|な}くなり→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧、⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}いだ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧。
examples.english: The previous family head passed away, and his son succeeded him.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代々|だいだい}→代々：05899_daidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{当主|とうしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧てきた⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This house has traditions that successive family heads have continued to protect.

notes:
{当主|とうしゅ} refers to the current head of a family or household. It carries a formal, traditional tone and is especially common in historical fiction, discussions of noble families, and family business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{先代|せんだい}→先代：14793_sendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{当主|とうしゅ}: previous family head
- ⟦{現|げん}→現〜：03950_gen⟧{当主|とうしゅ}: current family head
- ⟦{次期|じき}→次期：19838_jiki⟧{当主|とうしゅ}: next family head
- {当主|とうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧: to succeed as family head

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {家長|かちょう}: head of household (broader, more general)
- ⟦{主人|しゅじん}→主人：00987_shujin⟧: master, head of household (everyday usage)
- ⟦{世帯主|せたいぬし}→世帯主：15836_setainushi⟧: head of household (administrative term)
